_comment: Phase 167.1.1.1 plan 02 (D-15, D-16, D-18). Shared oracle for the matcher's AUM basis. Both runners read this whole file: vitest (src/lib/holding-equity-contribution.parity.test.ts) replays it against holdingEquityContribution AND holdingEquityContributionLocal; pytest (analytics-service/tests/test_holding_equity_contribution.py) replays it against holding_equity_contribution. Every figure is hand-typed; nothing is derived from the code under test. expected_ts is what BOTH TypeScript functions return; expected_py is what the Python helper returns. They differ ONLY on the D-18 case (a derivative whose unrealized_pnl_usd is null: TypeScript counts 0, Python returns null so the caller withholds it as pnl_missing). JSON cannot carry NaN or Infinity, so a field holding one is written {"nonfinite": "NaN" | "Infinity" | "-Infinity"} and decoded identically by both runners.
